:::: {.concept-card key="action-chunk" tags="robotics"}
## action chunk

An ordered sequence of proposed robot commands for several control steps.
The controller may execute only part of the chunk before replacing it.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="behavioural-cloning" tags="machine-learning robotics"}
## behavioural cloning

Learning a policy from demonstrated observations and actions using a supervised learning objective.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="bounding-box" tags="machine-learning robotics"}
## bounding box

A rectangle used to specify the location and extent of a region in an image, under a stated coordinate convention.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="discounted-return" tags="machine-learning robotics"}
## discounted return

A sum of rewards along a trajectory in which later rewards are multiplied by progressively higher powers of a discount factor.
Its expectation is one common reinforcement-learning objective.
::::

:::: {.concept-card key="policy" tags="machine-learning robotics"}
## policy

A rule for choosing actions from available information, such as a state, observation, or history.
It may return an action directly or specify a distribution from which an action is selected.
::::
